caption: The drawing features three renderings of a decorative hair comb, each depicted in varying levels of detail and size. The central and largest comb is drawn in fine detail with a symmetrical design; it consists of five long, narrow tines and a wide top section. The top section is ornate, displaying a pattern of elongated, leaf-like shapes radiating upward and outward, each decorated with circular dots near their base, and intricate foliate and floral motifs in the center. Two smaller, less detailed versions of the comb are positioned below and to either side of the main image, rendered in lighter lines. The entire drawing is executed in grayscale pencil on a beige or light tan paper, and the artist’s signature, "Vincent Brugg," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Comb
